note: All five proposal anchors were re-checked against the fix commits and the frozen v3.7.7 tree; each anchored line is a removed line of the fix hunk. Applied in one batch.

rows.reason: Fix 829121032145 'Handle truncation in the middle of a GNU long linkname' removes archive_entry_set_link(entry, linkpath.s) from header_gnu_longlink, which is exactly line 1148 in the frozen v3.7.7 source; the truncation handling that replaces it is the fix for the heap over-read the advisory describes.

Fix 09685126fcec 'rar: Fix double free with over 4 billion nodes (#2598)' changes the node/cursor counters that overflow; the removed 'unsigned int i;' declaration at frozen line 1189 is inside archive_read_format_rar_seek_data, the function named by the advisory, and the struct counters (cursor/nodes unsigned int -> size_t) are changed in the same commit.

Fix ef093729521f 'warc: Prevent signed integer overflow (#2568)' guards cntlen against INT64_MAX in _warc_rdhdr and clamps the consume in _warc_skip; the removed _warc_skip(a) call at frozen line 389 (WT_CONT/LAST_WT default branch) is the sink that was reached with the overflowed size.

Fix 7c02cde37a63 'Fix overflow in build_ustar_entry (#2588)' removes the hardcoded 'size_t suffix_length = 99;' at frozen line 1574 (and the prefix_end = prefix + 155 bound) so both the prefix and suffix fit the 255-byte ustar field; that off-by-one is the 1-byte write overflow in the advisory.

Fix dcbf1e0ededa 'Do not skip past EOF while reading (#2584)' removes the unconditional 'if (is_disk_like) mine->use_lseek = 1;' at frozen line 403 and restricts lseek use to regular files, so a pipe-backed descriptor no longer seeks past EOF; the removed line is present verbatim at the anchor.
